summary: Namesquat beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and import
details: The package @ppa-web-components/ppa-hotel-collection@1.0.0 ships no real functionality: index.js exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for any accessed property. Its only effect is firing beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON payload containing the installer's hostname, install path, cwd, and Node.js version to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon fires both from a postinstall lifecycle script (`node beacon.cjs`) and on require() of the main module, so installer host-identifying data is sent to attacker-controlled infrastructure automatically on `npm install` and on any import. The scoped name combined with the no-op shim is consistent with a dependency-confusion / namesquat reconnaissance probe.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
